Predict Posterior Mean Only Using GP Internals

obtain_mean_internal.Rd

Computes the posterior mean at new input locations using precomputed GP internals.

Usage

obtain_mean_internal(xnew, intern, covfn, D)

Arguments

xnew

Numeric vector or matrix of new input locations. Each row is a test point.

intern

Precomputed GP internals (list) returned by predict_gp_internal.

covfn

Covariance-generating function (e.g. from cov_generator).

D

Integer. Dimensionality of the input space.

Value

Numeric vector of posterior means at the new locations.

Details

This function reuses precomputed Cholesky factorizations and regression coefficients from intern to quickly evaluate the GP posterior mean without recomputing the covariance inversion.

Examples

# Not run
# intern <- predict_gp_internal(data, nv, covfn)
# obtain_mean_internal(xnew, intern, covfn, D)
